pages.ja:
「臓硯………………！！！！」
カタをつけてやる。
臓硯はこの屋敷の何処かにいる筈だ、見つけだして今度こそ殺してやる……！

pages.en:
“Zouken……!”

I will settle this.

Zouken must be somewhere in the mansion. I will find him and kill him this time…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Zouken……!!!!”
I’ll settle it now.
Zouken should be somewhere in this house. I’ll find him and kill him…!

pages.ja:
「くそ、何処にいやがる爺ぃ……！」
家の何処にも臓硯の姿がない。
気配は刻一刻と薄れていく。
“ほうほう。まともな判断も出来ぬほど血が巡ったか。
おぬしはもう少し知恵が回ると思っておったが”
笑い声さえ小さくなる。

pages.en:
“Damn it! Where are you, old man…!?”

Zouken is nowhere in the house.

His presence grows fainter by the moment.

“Oh, dear. Has the blood rushed to your head so thoroughly that you can no longer make a rational decision?

“I had thought you possessed a little more wit.”

Even his laughter fades.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Damn it, where are you, you old bastard…!?”
I can’t find him anywhere in the house.
His presence is fading by the second.
‘Oh, my. You must be blinded by your anger.
I thought you would be smarter.’
Even his laughing voice is fading away.

始めからこの建物にはいなかった。
ヤツは蟲使いだ、この屋敷にいたのは手足となる蟲だけだった……！

“Hah—hah, hah, hah—!”

…Zouken is not here.

He was never inside this building.

He commands worms. Nothing but the worms that serve as his hands and feet had ever been inside this mansion…!

He’s a worm user. The only ones here are his worms…!

『満足したかね？ では帰るがいい衛宮士郎。
桜はじきイリヤスフィールを呑み込む。急がねば、おまえが育てた怪物の誕生に立ち会えなくなるぞ？』
「っ、クソ爺ぃ……！」
pages.jaRuby:
『満足したかね？ では帰るがいい衛宮士郎。

「っ、クソ爺ぃ……！」
pages.en:
“Are you satisfied? Then return home, Shirou Emiya.

“Sakura will soon swallow Illyasviel. Unless you hurry, you will miss the birth of the monster you raised.”

“You damned old man…!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Are you satisfied now? Then go home, Emiya Shirou.
Sakura will soon swallow Illyasviel. If you do not hurry, you will not be there for the birth of the monster you raised.”
“You old bastard…!”

pages.ja:
足よ千切れよ、とばかりに地面を蹴る。
怒りにまかせて時間を浪費してしまった。
屋敷まで全力で走って二十分。
間に合うか。
桜とイリヤが顔を合わせる前に、なんとしても家に戻らないと
！

pages.en:
I drive my feet against the earth as though willing my legs to tear themselves apart.

I wasted precious time surrendering to my anger.

The mansion is twenty minutes away at a dead run.

—Can I make it?

I have to return before Sakura and Illya meet, no matter what it takes—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I kick the ground hard enough to rip my legs off.
Giving in to my anger wasted too much time.
It’ll take twenty minutes to get to my house, even if I run full-speed.
Will I make it?
I have to head back to my house before Sakura finds Illya
!
